items.text: New hc_client_registry.rs: HcClientRegistry holds role-keyed Option<Arc<HcClient>> (infrastructure + imagodei), connects each role at startup, non-fatal on failure
Refactor main.rs heartbeat block to consume registry.infrastructure instead of constructing its own inline HcClient (no behavior change)

Forwarder helpers in account.rs: forward_self_revocation / forward_revocation_vote / forward_add_portal_host / forward_remove_portal_host — verify owner, deserialize InputView, From->zome input, call_zome, decode response
Mode gate verify_caller_owns_cell: compares hc.cell_id agent key against resolved agent_key; returns 503 BROWSER_WRITE_PATH_PENDING on mismatch
Two distinct 503 contracts replacing single PHASE_11_PENDING: BROWSER_WRITE_PATH_PENDING (owner mismatch) + IMAGODEI_BRIDGE_OFFLINE (hc connect failed); shared envelope, Angular switches on code
Route dispatch update: four account.rs arms call handle_* wrappers (resolve agent key, check Some(hc), forward) instead of zome_bridge_not_yet_wired
map_zome_err_to_http: string-match well-known zome error prefixes to 403/400/503/500 (PHASE-11-DEBT marker for typed-errors deferral)
Eventual-consistency: handlers respond on zome Ok immediately, do not wait on projection-signal echo into SQLite
Mocking strategy: trait CellOwner that HcClient implements; verify_caller_owns_cell takes &dyn CellOwner; hand-rolled stub in tests
Unit tests: remove two stub 503 tests; add owner-match-pass, owner-mismatch-503, and four map_zome_err_to_http cases
Acceptance: four /api/v1/account/* routes call imagodei coordinator via registered HcClient when cell-owner matches resolved agent key
Acceptance: remove five @phase11-pending tags across four feature files; corresponding scenarios pass on Jenkins (live verification surface)
Out of scope (M6): defender path submit_specialist_revocation, browser-mode write forwarding, HA/reconnect pool, hashcash/rate-limiting, typed error contracts over conductor wire
